findings.description: Heinrich (Henry) Dewus died on or about 23 August 1936 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The tree already carries an undated Death fact; the agent should recover the date (and place) of death. The hint obituary is stamped 28 August 1936, but that is the print date — a separate death notice and a memorial the family published exactly one year later both establish the actual death as 23 August 1936.
supporting_sources: United States, GenealogyBank Historical Newspaper Obituaries, 1815-2013 — obituary printed 28 Aug 1936, Milwaukee (6906 W. Lloyd St.), jointly indexed under Henry Dewus and Henry Downs (ark:/61903/1:1:Q5SZ-SH29)
United States, GenealogyBank Historical Newspaper Obituaries, 1815-2013 — the 'Henry Dewus' persona indexes Death 23 Aug 1936 with obituary 28 Aug 1936, Milwaukee (ark:/61903/1:1:Q5SZ-J9LG)
A separate death notice and a memorial the family published exactly one year later both give the actual date of death as 23 Aug 1936 (the obituary's 28 Aug 1936 is the print date)

findings.description: Heinrich Dewus had a son not yet in the tree: Walter (Dewus), living in Wisconsin when his father died in 1936. The tree's four known children are Alma (b. 1882), Adela (b. 1883), Hedwig (b. 1885), and Heinrich Charles (b. 1889).
supporting_sources: United States, GenealogyBank Historical Newspaper Obituaries, 1815-2013 — the 1936 obituary names sons Walter and Henry C. (the tree's Heinrich Charles) among the surviving children (ark:/61903/1:1:Q5SZ-SH23; joint entry ark:/61903/1:1:Q5SZ-SH29)

findings.description: The 1936 obituary also names a daughter Miss Eleanor Downs of Chicago, not in the tree. Her surname is indexed under the obituary's variant 'Downs', so her identity is the least certain of the named children — bonus credit if recovered.
